paragraphs: I build full stack AI products and the backend services behind them. At Airspan Networks I own an incident-investigation workspace end to end, from product discovery to production, using React/TypeScript, Python/FastAPI and PostgreSQL.

I treat AI features as products that need measurement. I iterate with pilot feedback and evaluate retrieval quality, agent tool selection and argument validity on held-out tasks. That work took task completion from 82% to 94% and weekly active usage from 38% to 71% of enabled users.

Earlier, at Rakuten Symphony, I built Python REST APIs, asynchronous workers and React dashboards for infrastructure events. I also cut p95 API latency from 800 ms to 310 ms by fixing inefficient SQL queries and missing indexes.
